topic: EXP-616 verification — Version History freeze, V6.0 changelog, Mansinha citation, IGRF-14, security-note update

holes_found.description: p6 introduces href="security-audit.md" but docs/security-audit.md does not exist. The file lives at the repo root (security-audit.md, confirmed by find). GitHub Pages serves from docs/ so the link resolves to funwithscience.net/dome-model-review/security-audit.md — a 404. The EXP's verification claim ('docs/security-audit.md confirmed present in docs/') is incorrect. Pre-patch was bare filename text (no hyperlink), so this is a regression: an inert bare filename became an actively-broken hyperlink. The download card in the site header uses href="../security-audit.md" (also broken on the live site, but at least consistently one level up). Fix: either (a) remove the href and revert to bare filename text, matching the pre-patch semantics; or (b) add docs/security-audit.md as a build artifact so the link resolves; or (c) use href="../security-audit.md" to match the download card convention (same breakage pattern, but consistent).
holes_found.proposed_fix: Change href="security-audit.md" to plain text "security-audit.md" (reverting to the pre-patch non-hyperlink form) since no routable copy of the file exists in the served docs/ directory. Alternatively, copy security-audit.md into docs/ as part of the build pipeline.

summary_for_decider: All 6 EXP-616 patches landed cleanly: frozen values in V4 (67 WINs, 28 reviews), V6.0/V6.0+ changelog entries, TLDR rewrite, Mansinha citation, IGRF-13/14 update, and Security Note prose. One minor seam artifact: p6 introduces href="security-audit.md" but docs/security-audit.md doesn't exist (file is at repo root, not served by GitHub Pages from docs/); the pre-patch bare filename was inert but the new hyperlink actively 404s. Easiest fix is to drop the href and keep it as plain text, or add the file to docs/ as a build step.
